name: mdx-harness-policy-profiles
rules: policy profiles define baseline harness limits
enterprise packs may narrow behavior but cannot widen trust boundaries
enterprise packs cannot enable secrets, network access, larger budgets, looser retention, weaker redaction, or local audit export
enterprise pack contracts are enforced during provider selection
manifest enterprise pack mismatches fail closed with denied provider receipts
customer-specific architecture belongs in named packs, not runtime branches
forbidden_capabilities: no project-local widening of trust boundaries
no provider secrets in policy artifacts
no live status without enforcing runtime proof
